description: Source code for a ZIP extraction utility using yauzl, implementing an Extractor class with methods to extract ZIP entries, handle symlinks, directories, and manage extraction modes. It exports an async function to initialize extraction with given options.

classes.name: Extractor
classes.description: A class that handles extracting ZIP files, processing entries, creating directories, handling symlinks, and setting file modes.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Opens the ZIP file, reads entries, and processes each entry for extraction.

methods.name: extractEntry
methods.description: Extracts a single ZIP entry, creating directories, handling symlinks, and writing files.

methods.name: getExtractedMode
methods.description: Determines the file mode for extracted entries, applying defaults if necessary.
